page.layout: Running head at top, with page number 45 at top right. One column of running text, with a row of printer's marginal marks ("«") down the right side. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: nis locus: Marcum uerò Manilium nos etiam uidimus transverso ambulantem foro: quod erat insigne, eū qui id faceret, facere ciuibus omnibus consilij sui copiam: ad quos olim & ita ambulātes, & in folio sedentes domi, sic adibatur, non solùm ut de lu[?] re ciuili ad eos, uerùm etiam de filia collocanda, de fundo emendo, de agro colendo, de omni denique aut officio aut negotio referretur. Eòdem etiam ille, ex oratione Crassi in M.Brutum, Bruti iurisconsulti filium, iocus pertinet, qui est in libro secundo: Brute quid sedes? quid illam anum

page.notes: The "«" signs down the right margin are printer's line marks, not words, so they are not transcribed as notes. The word "lu" at the line end before "re" is unclear; the likely word is "iure". The word "iocus" is printed as shown. The running head "IVRISCONSVLTVS." is normalised to IURISCONSULTUS. under the rule for u/v. No other text, stains and dots at the foot are not printed text.
